title: ESLint Custom Error Message That AI Agents Can Fix
description:
Vague lint errors leave your AI agent guessing. One line fixes that. 🛠️

✅ Add a message to no-restricted-imports
✅ Tell the agent exactly what to use instead
✅ Run npx eslint and see the fix in the error

Day 4 of Agent Harness. Next up: Day 5, Keep a Progress File for Long Tasks.
Follow for a new short every day and build AI agents you can trust.

#shorts #aitools #coding #aicoding #aiagents #eslint #claudecode #programming
comment: Fix hint or docs link: which helps agents more? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: name the exact folder or function to use instead, so the agent can fix it in one step.
